$comment: Human-checked word times: the TIMIT sample that NLTK distributes (16 of TIMIT's 630 speakers, 10 sentences each; word times hand-verified by LDC). CC BY-NC-SA, unlike the other sets: the audio is downloaded, never stored in the repository. TIMIT is a classic test set and likely in the engines' training data, so its WER says little; it is here for word timing. Selection rules and license: DATASETS.md. The audio is stored as FLAC. Fetch with: node bench/fetch.mjs --clips bench/clips.timit.json (checksums in bench/checksums.timit.json).
